summary: React to a piece of content, such as a post, video, or comment, by clicking its corresponding like, upvote, or reaction button.
preconditions: The target content item is visible on the screen, either in a feed, list, or detail view.
steps: Locate the target content item on the page.
Identify the reaction control associated with the item (such as a heart icon, thumbs-up icon, or upvote arrow).
Click the reaction control to register your reaction.

variants.when: The platform uses upvotes/downvotes instead of likes
variants.do: Click the up arrow icon to upvote the content.

variants.when: The platform uses a heart or thumbs-up icon
variants.do: Click the heart or thumbs-up icon to like the content.

watch_for: The reaction icon changing color or filling in (e.g., a heart turning red, an arrow turning orange).
The reaction count next to the icon incrementing by one.
completion_signal: The reaction control transitions to its active, highlighted, or filled state.
pitfalls: Clicking the reaction button a second time, which will undo/unlike the content.
Clicking the reaction button of an adjacent post or comment by mistake when scrolling quickly.
